construction.base: immutable HVCELV-8 event times, entry and hold
construction.state_grid: every exact 03:00/11:00/19:00 UTC using [D-8h,D) completed data
construction.premium_activity: sum of absolute one-minute bars_binance_premium close differences
construction.btc_activity: sqrt(sum squared BTCUSDT one-minute log-close returns)
construction.rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 270 valid state-grid blocks, minimum 180, current excluded
construction.router: relative activity rank<=0.50 keeps immutable HVCELV side; rank>0.50 flips it

mechanism.claim: Cross-alt persistence that survives an Ehlers veto should continue when derivative premium repricing is quiet relative to BTC path variation, but reverse when premium repricing is unusually active and signals crowded derivative-led movement.
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: sparse HVCELV events retain their irregular incidence while premium-state polarity changes signed exposure independently of Gross9

clock.funding: not a signal; exact held settlements sealed until economics

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

research_boundary.classification: exploratory discovery; not fresh confirmatory evidence
research_boundary.selection_basis: relative premium repricing activity as an independent causal crowding polarity state

stopping_rule: source support, Gross9, train/test/eval/final; stop first failure; no rank, median, direction, base, side, clock, hold, subset, substitution, or control repair.
